data.one_liner: Customizable dropdown with autocomplete, multi-select, and nested hierarchy
data.what_it_does: Provides a dropdown widget that supports type-ahead search, multi-selection, and unlimited nested data structures. It offers extensive styling, pagination, and form integration.
use_when: Need a searchable dropdown with custom item widgets
Require multi-select capability with chip display
Handle hierarchical data such as categories or file systems
avoid_when: Only a simple static dropdown is required
Performance constraints demand a lightweight widget
strengths: Supports unlimited nested hierarchy with expand/collapse
Pagination and debounced search for large datasets
weaknesses: Large API surface can be overwhelming for simple use cases
No built-in theming beyond standard Flutter widgets
